extracted.intended_audience: startup founders, CEOs, and communications/PR leads preparing a pivot announcement press release
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and template for writing a press release announcing a company pivot: when to announce, what to include (headline, lede, body paragraphs, boilerplate), and a quality checklist for tone, substance, and stakeholder impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Why Pivot Announcements Are Tricky
rubrics_metrics.description: Identifies key risks and sensitivities when announcing a pivot publicly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confessing prior approach didn't work; Risk of investor confidence; Customer migration challenges; Employee morale considerations; Competitor positioning opportunity. Use these as framing constraints when choosing tone, timing, and level of detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: When to Announce a Pivot Publicly
rubrics_metrics.description: Situations that justify a public pivot announcement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Existing customers need transition information; Funding rounds tied to new direction; New target market needs awareness; Building credibility through honesty; Hiring needs new positioning. If one or more apply, favor a public announcement that addresses the relevant stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: When NOT to Announce Publicly
rubrics_metrics.description: Situations where a public announcement is inappropriate or unnecessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quiet pivot mid-stealth; Internal restructuring without external impact; Customer base too small to matter; Investor-only communication needed. In these cases prefer private or investor-focused communications and avoid broad public messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline
rubrics_metrics.description: The short, attention-getting summary of the pivot in the press release header.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template options given on page: "[Company] Pivots from [Old Focus] to [New Focus]" or "[Company] Sharpens Focus on [New Direction]". Keep it specific about old vs new focus or clearly signal a sharpened direction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lede
rubrics_metrics.description: Opening sentence/paragraph that announces the pivot and summarizes the rationale and next steps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template lede: "[Company] today announced a strategic pivot from [old focus] to [new focus], driven by [specific market insight]. The company will [specific actions] over the next [timeframe]." Use a concise statement of change, why, and what will happen next.

rubrics_metrics.name: Para 1: What's Changing
rubrics_metrics.description: First body paragraph should clearly state the change being made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include specific old focus / specific new focus; Timeline of transition; Geographic or segment changes. Be explicit about scope and timing so readers understand concrete implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Para 2: Why Now
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain the market and internal evidence that prompted the pivot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite the market insight that drove the decision; customer feedback patterns; competitive landscape shifts; internal data findings. Use concrete evidence rather than vague assertions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Para 3: What This Means For Customers
rubrics_metrics.description: Detail customer-facing impacts and the plan for transitioning users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover existing customer transition plan; support for migration; pricing implications; timeline for changes. Anticipate customer concerns and provide reassurance and practical steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Para 4: What This Means For Employees
rubrics_metrics.description: Address internal impacts to keep employees informed and minimize morale issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discuss roles affected; new hiring areas; cultural continuity; leadership team. Be transparent about changes to responsibilities and hiring priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Para 5: Quote
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a substantive quote from leadership (typically the CEO) that is honest and forward-looking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CEO honest about the journey; specific market insight; acknowledgment of customers' patience; vision for new direction. The quote should humanize the decision and provide credibility, not just platitudes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Boilerplate
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated company description and mission statement to reflect the new direction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an updated company description; articulate the new mission; maintain context such as founded date and scale. Boilerplate should be consistent with the rest of the release and usable by journalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honesty as Strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Use candid, factual framing about prior approach and learning as a positive strategic move.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledge what didn't work; cite specific learnings; avoid blaming others; frame as an informed decision; invite scrutiny on new direction. Honesty builds credibility with customers, investors, and press when paired with evidence and a clear plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: What Works: Concrete data driving decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Support the pivot narrative with concrete data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specific metrics or findings that directly motivated the pivot so the decision reads as evidence-driven rather than reactive.

rubrics_metrics.name: What Works: Customer voice acknowledging change
rubrics_metrics.description: Include or reference customer input that supports the pivot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use customer quotes, testimonials, or summarized feedback patterns to show the pivot responds to real user needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: What Works: Investor support quote
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate investor backing for the new direction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A quote or statement from investors signals confidence and reduces concerns about funding or strategic viability.

rubrics_metrics.name: What Works: Roadmap clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a clear, actionable roadmap for the pivot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outline near-term actions and timelines so stakeholders understand what will happen and when; avoid vague promises.

rubrics_metrics.name: What Works: Honest acknowledgment of challenges
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledge remaining risks or hurdles candidly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Call out major challenges and how the company plans to address them to avoid appearing naive or evasive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Rubric for Pivots: Honest framing of change
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate whether the announcement frames the pivot honestly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Does the release clearly admit prior shortcomings and present the pivot as a learned, strategic choice rather than spin?

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Rubric for Pivots: Specific market insight cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Check for concrete market evidence cited in support of the pivot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for named data points, trends, customer behaviors, or competitive moves that justify the change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Rubric for Pivots: Customer impact addressed
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the announcement explains implications and support for customers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Does the release present a plan for customer migration, support, pricing changes, and timelines?

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Rubric for Pivots: Employee impact addressed
rubrics_metrics.description: Verify the announcement responsibly covers employee effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Does it mention roles affected, hiring plans, cultural continuity, and leadership changes to preserve morale?

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Rubric for Pivots: Substantive CEO quote
rubrics_metrics.description: Require a meaningful leadership quote that adds context and credibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The CEO's quote should include acknowledgment of the journey, a specific insight, and a forward-looking vision—not generic PR language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Rubric for Pivots: Roadmap clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess whether the release gives a clear roadmap for execution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Is there a timeline and concrete next steps for stakeholders to understand how the pivot will be implemented?

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Rubric for Pivots: Investor support visible
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for visible indications of investor backing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investor quotes or mentions of funding tied to the pivot reduce credibility concerns and should be included where applicable.
